note: Swift County park on the banks of the Chippewa River in the village of Swift Falls, below the old mill dam, northeast of Benson. Camper sites sit in small groups around the park's shelters on open lawn and under trees; hiking trails with footbridges, fishing below the dam and a playground. Firewood is sold across the river by the dam. --Claude
summary: County page, brochure and site map read: 18 camper sites (named on the map) plus tent and island sites, modern restrooms and showers, no dump station, May-October, ResNexus online booking or phone. ResNexus refused (Incapsula) so the stored $30 (ResNexus 2026-10-10) stands unre-read. Water/electric confirmed only in general terms. Not waterfront kept; note cleaned.
flags: FACILITIES: dump station absent per the county brochure ('The Park does not have a waste dump station at this time, but there are stations in Benson and Glenwood'); written dump false. The brochure is undated; the old note and listings did not claim one either.

HOOKUPS: the brochure says only 'Electric and water hook-ups are available for those with motor homes, campers, and trailers.' Stored electric 30 / water true (derived from Campendium/Dyrt via note prose) left alone; amperage is not on any county page.

FEES: stored $30 (ResNexus 'standard rate $30/night', read 2026-10-10, audit/price_research/residue_1.json) left as is; ResNexus answered an Incapsula challenge today and was not retried. The county brochure's table ('Campers: $20.00/night, Tents: $8.00/night, Shelters: $30.00/day') is older and superseded by the engine.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the county map puts camper sites 4B-4D (by Shelter 4, about 45.4002,-95.4214) and 1C-1D (by the dam, about 45.4016,-95.4224) nearest the Chippewa; on Esri imagery the channel there is only ~10-15 m wide (creek-sized below the dam) and the nearest camper pads are ~30-40 m back behind a band of bank trees. Not enough for creekside on open ground; no change proposed.
SITES max_rig_ft: the old note's 'rigs to about 45 ft' came from Campendium/Dyrt; no county page states a length. Dropped from the note; no field was set.
PIN 45.401104,-95.420612 is the open field in the middle of the park, among the site groups; confirmed (site groups spread ~150 m around it).
